regions.name: Paraguay
regions.quote: The Cuiabá is itself a tributary of the rio Paraguay and its lower reaches flow through the Pantanal wetlands.

regions.name: Rio Paraguay-Paraná
regions.quote: The catfish originates from clear water streams with a strong current in the upper part of the Rio Paraguay-Paraná river basin.
